newsitem.title: USA: DSC SETS $300 MLN NOTES OFFERING.
newsitem.headline: DSC SETS $300 MLN NOTES OFFERING.

text.p: DSC Communications Corp said Thursday it is selling a new issue of $300 million of 7.0 percent convertible subordinated notes due August 2004, priced at par.
The notes are convertible into DSC's common stock, at the option of the holder, at a conversion price of $49.725 per share, DSC said.
The notes are being offered through Goldman, Sachs & Co and NationsBanc Capital Markets, a company official said.
The underwriters have been granted a 30-day option to buy up to an additional $100 million of the notes to cover over-allotments, the company said.

James Donald, DSC chairman and chief executive officer, said net proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, capital expenditures, and possible acquisitions and longer term financing arrangements for customers.
Additionally, a portion of the proceeds could be used to repay all or a portion of outstanding long-term borrowings, he said.
DSC is a global provider of advanced telecommunications products, including digital switching, transmission, access and network management systems.
